requirements.general: Science Degrees (Degrees other than Medical/ Dental/ Pharmacy) SPM / O-Level or equivalent Minimum 5 credits including Mathematics and 2 Science subjects and a pass in Bahasa Melayu and English. UEC Minimum 4Bs including Mathematics and 2 Science subjects. Medical/ Dental/ Pharmacy Degrees SPM / O-Level or equivalent Minimum 5 credits including Grade B and above for Mathematics, Additional Mathematics,Physics, Chemistry and Biology or a Technical subject and pass in Bahasa Melayu and English. UEC Minimum 5Bs including Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology or a Technical subject and pass in Bahasa Melayu and English. English language Requirements (For International Students) MUET minimum 3.0 IELTS minimum 4.0 TOEFL minimum 5 (ESS OL)/ 30-31 (iBT) Pearson minimum 36 Linguaskill OL minimum 140 ELS minimum 106
